00050 #define DEFAULT_UGEN_DOCS   <I>Not yet documented although the argument name should be reasonably clear</I>.
00051 #define COMMON_UGEN_DOCS    <B>Generic %UGen argument documentation:</B>                                        \
00052                             Arguments which are UGen type can be continuously controlled and these              \
00053                             may generally be multichannel (although there are some exceptions).                 \
00054                             Arguments which are constant/literal values (e.g., float or int) are clearly        \
00055                             not continuously controllable and not multichannel (therefore will                  \
00056                             generallly be applied identically to each channel should the UGen being             \
00057                             created is made multichannel via other arguments.                                   \
00058                             Arguments which are Buffer type may require a Buffer for some specific              \
00059                             purpose (e.g, TableOsc uses a buffer for its wavetable) but single channel          \
00060                             Buffer objects are also used to specify an array of literal values (e.g., LLine)    \
00061                             \n\
00062                             \n\

00698     inline float* processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel = -1) throw()
00699     {   
00700         ugen_assert(numInternalUGens > 0);
00701         ugen_assert(internalUGens != 0);
00702         
00703         if(channel < 0) {
00704             // process all channels
00705             for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00706                 internalUGens[i]->processBlockInternal(shouldDelete, blockID, i);
00707             
00708             return 0;
00709         } else {
00710             // process one channel and return a pointer to its block
00711             int internalChannel = channel % numInternalUGens;
00712             float* block = internalUGens[internalChannel]->processBlockInternal(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00713             return block;
00714         }
00715     }

00727     float* prepareAndProcessBlock(const int actualBlockSize, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel = -1) throw();
00728     
00736     inline void prepareForBlock(const int actualBlockSize, const unsigned int blockID) throw()
00737     {   
00738         ugen_assert(actualBlockSize > 0);
00739         ugen_assert(numInternalUGens > 0);
00740         ugen_assert(internalUGens != 0);
00741         
00742         bool shouldDelete = false;
00743         
00744         for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++) {
00745             if(internalUGens[i]->shouldBeDeletedNow(blockID)) {
00746                 shouldDelete = true;
00747                 break;
00748             }
00749         }
00750         
00751         if(shouldDelete) {
00752             for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00753                 internalUGens[i]->decrementRefCount();
00754             
00755             numInternalUGens = 1;
00756             internalUGens[0] = getNullInternal();
00757             internalUGens[0]->prepareForBlockInternal(actualBlockSize, blockID);        
00758         } else {
00759             for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00760                 internalUGens[i]->prepareForBlockInternal(actualBlockSize, blockID);
00761         }
00762     }

01068     inline static void initialise() throw()
01069     {
01070         if(isInitialised == false)
01071         {
01072 //          null = UGen();
01073 //          nullKr = UGen().kr();
01074             
01075             
01076             null = UGen();
01077             nullKr = null.kr();
01078 
01079             Buffer::tableSine512  = Buffer::line( 513, 0.0, 2.0 * pi).sin().shrinkSize();
01080             Buffer::tableSine8192 = Buffer::line(8193, 0.0, 2.0 * pi).sin().shrinkSize();
01081             Buffer::tableCosine512  = Buffer::line( 513, 0.0, 2.0 * pi).cos().shrinkSize();
01082             Buffer::tableCosine8192 = Buffer::line(8193, 0.0, 2.0 * pi).cos().shrinkSize();
01083 //          Buffer::tableSine512  = Buffer::line( 1025, 0.0, 4.0 * pi).sin().shrinkSize(512);
01084 //          Buffer::tableSine8192 = Buffer::line(16385, 0.0, 4.0 * pi).sin().shrinkSize(8192);
01085 
01086             Buffer constantPanTemp;
01087             constantPanTemp = Buffer::line(512, -pi4, pi4) << Buffer::line(512, pi4, -pi4);
01088             Buffer::tableConstantPan512 = (constantPanTemp.cos() - constantPanTemp.sin()) * sqrt22;
01089             isInitialised = true;
01090         }
01091     }
